issues.title: E90031 members missing this morning
issues.body:
Hi, Synthetic Supplies rang. Their new joiners from Monday's file aren't showing. Same for two other employers I think (E90044 and E90052?). The files definitely arrived on the 9th because ops confirmed it. Is it the files or is it us?

Thanks, Mel (Employer Relations)

issues.title: job crashes if a file isnt there
issues.body:
ran the job with yesterday's list. one of the files had been moved by ops and the whole thing died with a FileNotFoundException and a stack trace. the other files in the list never loaded.

surely it should say that file is rejected and carry on, like it does for a bad trailer?

issues.title: MemberFeedReader needs IngestionOptions
issues.body:
the feed reader takes IOptions<IngestionOptions> just to read StrictSchema. thats the Feeds namespace reaching up into Ingestion. it also means you cant new up a reader in a small tool without building the whole options thing.

could Read just take a bool, and the ingestor pass it in? not urgent but it bugs me every time i see it. appsettings shouldnt need to change.

issues.title: No audit event when a member file is rejected
issues.body:
Audit asked which member files we turned away in October and I had to grep the logs to answer. We record member_file_loaded but nothing at all when a file is rejected.

Can we record an event for that too? Same actor. Put the reason in the detail but no field values obviously.

issues.title: job: total line at the end
issues.body:
when you give the job 30 files you get 30 reports and have to count the rejected ones by eye. a last line like

    30 files: 28 loaded, 2 rejected

would do. keep the per-file output as it is.

issues.title: Email the pack to the employer automatically
issues.body:
Could the job just email the ingest report and the joiners list to the employer's payroll contact when a file loads? It would save us an afternoon every month. We have the addresses in the employer system.

Mel (Employer Relations)

issues.title: reject files with extra columns
issues.body: E90001 sent a member file with an extra column last year (a PT/FT flag) and I'm told we loaded rubbish from it. Can the reader refuse files that have more columns than the contract says?

Jo

Sam
